# package telecontrol

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/telecontrol"
```

Package telecontrol holds the application procedures that IEC 60870-5-101 and IEC 60870-5-104 share (IEC 60870-5-5 as profiled by the two companion standards): how a controlling station recognises the answers to its requests, and how it runs the request kinds that are answered with a confirmation (commands, clock synchronization), with data and a termination (interrogation, counter interrogation) or with the data itself (read).

Neither companion standard has a transaction identifier: answers are recognised by type identification, common address, information object address and cause of transmission. A [Requester](#type-requester) keeps the outstanding requests and routes each received ASDU to the request it answers.

The package is transport independent: the companion standard packages supply a send function and feed received ASDUs to [Requester.Dispatch](#func-requester-dispatch).

## Variables

```go
var ErrBusy = errors.New("telecontrol: identical request pending")
```

ErrBusy reports a request that cannot be issued because an identical one is still awaiting its answer: the answers could not be told apart.

## Functions

### func Confirmation

```go
func Confirmation(req *asdu.ASDU) asdu.Cause
```

Confirmation returns the cause of the positive or negative confirmation of req: deactivation confirmation for a deactivation, activation confirmation otherwise.

### func FromStation

```go
func FromStation(p asdu.Params, req, a *asdu.ASDU) bool
```

FromStation reports whether a is monitor-direction data from the station (or stations) req addressed. Parameters of measured values (P\_ME\_NA\_1..P\_ME\_NC\_1) are control-direction types a station also reports in answer to an interrogation.

### func Mirrored

```go
func Mirrored(p asdu.Params, req, a *asdu.ASDU) bool
```

Mirrored reports whether a is the controlled station's mirror of req: a confirmation, termination or rejection. p tells the broadcast common address.

### func Rejected

```go
func Rejected(a *asdu.ASDU) error
```

Rejected returns a [\*NegativeError](#type-negativeerror) for a mirror that refuses its request, or nil.

NegativeError reports that the controlled station answered a request with a negative confirmation or with one of the "unknown ..." causes of transmission.

### type Requester

```go
type Requester struct {
	// Params are the ASDU parameters (for the broadcast address).
	Params asdu.Params
	// Send transmits a request. It is called without locks held.
	Send func(ctx context.Context, a *asdu.ASDU) error
	// Timeout bounds every request whose context has no earlier deadline.
	// Zero means no bound beyond the context.
	Timeout time.Duration

}
```

Requester runs requests of a controlling station. Its methods are safe for concurrent use.

#### func (Requester) ClockSync

```go
func (r *Requester) ClockSync(ctx context.Context, ca asdu.CommonAddr, t time.Time) error
```

ClockSync sends a clock synchronization command (C\_CS\_NA\_1).

#### func (Requester) Collect

```go
func (r *Requester) Collect(ctx context.Context, req *asdu.ASDU, cause asdu.Cause) ([]*asdu.ASDU, error)
```

Collect sends req and collects the process data the station sends with cause until the activation termination of req arrives. On error the data collected so far is returned with it.

#### func (Requester) Command

```go
func (r *Requester) Command(ctx context.Context, ca asdu.CommonAddr, obj asdu.InformationObject, deactivate bool) error
```

Command sends a process command with cause activation (or deactivation when deactivate is set) and waits for its confirmation.

#### func (Requester) Confirmed

```go
func (r *Requester) Confirmed(ctx context.Context, req *asdu.ASDU) error
```

Confirmed sends req and waits for its confirmation. A negative confirmation or an "unknown ..." answer is returned as a [\*NegativeError](#type-negativeerror). An activation termination that arrives first concludes an earlier request for the same object and is skipped.

#### func (Requester) CounterInterrogate

```go
func (r *Requester) CounterInterrogate(ctx context.Context, ca asdu.CommonAddr, request, freeze uint8) ([]*asdu.ASDU, error)
```

CounterInterrogate runs a counter interrogation (C\_CI\_NA\_1).

With freeze [asdu.FreezeRead](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/asdu#FreezeRead) it is a counter request: the station confirms, sends the integrated totals and terminates, and the totals are returned. With a freeze or reset qualifier it is a counter freeze command: the station only confirms it and sends no readings (IEC 60870-5-101:2003 7.4.8, mode C/D, figures 95 and 96), so the call returns at the confirmation with no data; collect the frozen values with a following request.

#### func (Requester) Dispatch

```go
func (r *Requester) Dispatch(a *asdu.ASDU) (consumed bool)
```

Dispatch hands a received ASDU to the requests it answers and reports whether one consumed it as a mirror (a confirmation, termination or rejection). Process data that answers an interrogation or read is delivered to the request and reported as not consumed, so the caller passes it on to the application as well.

#### func (Requester) FailAll

```go
func (r *Requester) FailAll(err error)
```

FailAll ends every outstanding request with err, for example when the link is lost.

#### func (Requester) Interrogate

```go
func (r *Requester) Interrogate(ctx context.Context, ca asdu.CommonAddr, qoi asdu.QOI) ([]*asdu.ASDU, error)
```

Interrogate runs an interrogation (C\_IC\_NA\_1) with qualifier qoi.

#### func (Requester) MeasureDelay

```go
func (r *Requester) MeasureDelay(ctx context.Context, ca asdu.CommonAddr) (time.Duration, error)
```

MeasureDelay measures the transmission delay to a station with the delay acquisition procedure (IEC 60870-5-101:2003 7.4.12): it sends C\_CD\_NA\_1 with cause activation carrying the sending time (second and millisecond of the minute, CP16Time2a), and the station's confirmation carries that time plus its reaction time. The one-way delay is half of the round trip less the reaction time.

The formula is that of IEC 60870-5-5 6.13 as IEC 60870-5-101 refers to it; we do not hold IEC 60870-5-5, so it is an interpretation. Send the result with [Requester.SetDelay](#func-requester-setdelay).

#### func (Requester) Read

```go
func (r *Requester) Read(ctx context.Context, ca asdu.CommonAddr, ioa asdu.IOA) (*asdu.ASDU, error)
```

Read sends a read command (C\_RD\_NA\_1) for ioa and returns the ASDU the station answers with cause "request" for that address.

#### func (Requester) ResetProcess

```go
func (r *Requester) ResetProcess(ctx context.Context, ca asdu.CommonAddr, qualifier uint8) error
```

ResetProcess sends a reset process command (C\_RP\_NA\_1).

#### func (Requester) SetDelay

```go
func (r *Requester) SetDelay(ctx context.Context, ca asdu.CommonAddr, d time.Duration) error
```

SetDelay sends the transmission delay d to the station: C\_CD\_NA\_1 with cause spontaneous ("set delay", IEC 60870-5-101:2003 7.3.4.7 and 7.4.12). The station corrects the time of every following clock synchronization command by it. No application answer is defined; the call returns when the link layer delivered the command. d is sent in milliseconds, 0..59999.

#### func (Requester) TestCommand

```go
func (r *Requester) TestCommand(ctx context.Context, ca asdu.CommonAddr, withTime bool) error
```

TestCommand sends a test command. With withTime set it is C\_TS\_TA\_1 with the test sequence counter, starting at 0 and incremented per command (IEC 60870-5-104 8.8), and the current time (the only test command of IEC 60870-5-104); otherwise C\_TS\_NA\_1 with the fixed test bit pattern (IEC 60870-5-101).
